text:
incident-bot: PAGER: [SEV=P1] prod-west GPU pool exhausted in prod-cluster-2. Cluster-autoscaler attempts failing; inference and batch queues rising. Paging @jorge (oncall). Runbook ref: https://rbwd/runbooks/gpu-autoscale

jorge: Oncall ack. Joining. Pulling queue size and pending pods.

nina: Queue snapshot (internal) -> inference-queue length: 2.6k, batch-queue length: 1.2k. Error rates low but latency elevated on embed endpoints.

jorge: kubectl get pod -n infra | egrep "Pending|0/1"
```
inference-svc-67ffd   0/1 Pending  0  14m
batch-job-9ab12      0/1 Pending  0  13m
```

jorge: kubectl describe pod inference-svc-67ffd -n infra -> Events show FailedScheduling: 0/10 nodes are available: 10 Insufficient gpu.

ops-bot: cluster-autoscaler: scaleUp: attempted to add 4 nodes to nodegroup gpu-main-ng but CreateInstance failed repeatedly. See cloud logs.

nina: Looking at autoscaler cloud logs -> a recurring error: "AccessDenied: iam:PassRole denied" when creating instances with new launch template instance profile. Also a separate warning about ASG max size reached for gpu-main-ng in us-west-2.

kai: Paste from autoscaler logs:
```
W0915 09:33:12 scale.go:142] ScaleUp: need 4 nodes
E0915 09:33:14 aws_cloud_provider.go:210] CreateInstance failed: AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/cluster-autoscaler-role is not authorized to perform: iam:PassRole on resource: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodNodeRole
```

jorge: So two blockers: (1) cluster-autoscaler can't pass the role for instances from the updated launch template; (2) gpu-main-ng is already at configured max size (we hit autoscaling cap). Both needed to be addressed.

nina: Quick mitigation options discussed: A) bump gpu-main-ng max size temporarily, B) scale up a pre-configured emergency nodegroup gpu-hotfix-ng that uses the old instance profile, C) patch deployments to add tolerations for the new taint key if nodes have a new taint. Which order?

jorge: Do B immediately (fast and low-risk), then patch IAM (kai) to recover autoscaler path, and then increase max size if needed. Also check for unexpected taint injection.

nina: Launching emergency nodegroup via terra-runner: 
```
terraform apply -var='asg_name=gpu-hotfix-ng' -auto-approve
```

infra-bot: terraform: apply started for gpu-hotfix-ng -> desired=3 requested. Instances launching: i-0b1c2d3e4f, i-0f1e2d3c4b

jorge: New nodes join the cluster but pods still Pending. Describing one node shows kubelet applied taint: "provider.redwood/gpu-reserve=true:NoSchedule". That taint is new from the updated userdata in the LT. Our inference pods don't have tolerations for that key.

nina: Rather than removing taints from nodes (risky), we can add a toleration to the deployment quickly so pods can schedule onto these emergency nodes. Patch command:
```
kubectl patch deploy inference-svc -n infra -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"tolerations":[{"key":"provider.redwood/gpu-reserve","operator":"Equal","value":"true","effect":"NoSchedule","tolerationSeconds":3600}]}}}}'
```

jorge: Applying patch now... pods are evicting/recreating and binding to new nodes. Replica count moving toward desired. Queue draining observed.

product-oncall: Customer impact: embedding endpoints 95p latency spiked to ~6.5s during peak; several customers on trial experienced slow responses for ~25m. Support ticket created: #4410. No elevated error rates.

support: Notifying affected customers; we're sending a short incident note and tagging enterprise partners.

kai: I'm drafting a minimal IAM policy to allow the cluster-autoscaler role to pass the instance role used by the launch template. Will open an infra PR and request expedited review from security. Policy snippet: 
```
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["iam:PassRole"],
  "Resource": ["arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodNodeRole"]
}
```

kai: Infra PR opened -> PR#1287. Pinged security for 20m review.

infra-bot: PR merged and IAM change applied by kai at 09:58 UTC: cluster-autoscaler-role allowed iam:PassRole -> RedwoodNodeRole

jorge: After IAM change, cluster-autoscaler retried and successfully created instances in gpu-main-ng. Also bumped gpu-main-ng max size by +5 to give headroom. New nodes register, and since we're patching the deploy with tolerations, pods schedule fine.

nina: Observability: queue length decreased from peak 3.8k to ~50 in 22 minutes after mitigations. Latency returning to baseline ~1.0s.

jorge: Incident summary for handoff:
- Root causes: (1) Launch template updated with a different instance profile without ensuring autoscaler can PassRole; (2) Launch template/userdata introduced a new taint key that pod specs lacked tolerations for; (3) ASG max size hit, limiting autoscaler ability to add nodes.
- Immediate mitigations: provisioned emergency nodegroup (gpu-hotfix-ng) using old instance profile; patched inference deployment with toleration to schedule on emergency nodes; applied IAM change to allow iam:PassRole; increased ASG max size to prevent immediate cap.
- Customer impact: embedding endpoints high tail latency for ~20-30m, queue peaked ~3.8k. Support ticket #4410. No data exposure.
- Timeframe: incident raised @2798769999 -> mitigated @2798770800 (~13.5m to major mitigation, full drain ~22m).

kai: Follow-ups I'll own: INFRA-901 ensure any LT that changes instance profile has a gating check for iam:PassRole; INFRA-902 remove unintended taint injector from userdata; INFRA-903 add pre-merge auto test that validates ASG max-size headroom and autoscaler simulations.

jorge: Postmortem owner: jorge. I'll coordinate with infra and security to ensure terraform changes and PRs include the new checks. I'll draft the customer-facing note with support.

support: Sending follow-up message to customers with timeline and mitigations. Linking ticket #4410 -> #4411 (internal).

infra-bot: Created follow-up tickets: INFRA-901, INFRA-902, INFRA-903 assigned to kai and nina.

jorge: Closing pager. Thanks for the fast coordination. If anything reappears, reopen in #incidents. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT: status -> mitigated; pager cleared. Please file postmortem doc in /incidents/postmortems within 48h."
